locations.name: Bens d'Avall
locations.description: ⚠️ CLOSED FOR ALL OF 2026 — the official website states the restaurant will remain closed throughout 2026 and plans to reopen in 2027. Was the region's iconic cliffside sunset fine-dining terrace (unanimously praised across the Instagram batch, previously a 5 on this list). Keep for a future Mallorca trip; not bookable for this one.
